newsitem.title: USA: IKON Office amends shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: IKON Office amends shareholder rights plan.

text.p: IKON Office Solutions said Wednesday it has extended and amended its shareholder rights plan, which was scheduled to expire in February 1998.
IKON said changes were prompted by the approaching expiration and that it is not aware that any acquisition proposals are likely at this time.

IKON said amendments included lowering the level of ownership or control of its common stock required to trigger exercise of shareholders' rights to 15 percent from 20 percent, said company spokesman Michael Kilpatric.
They also included raising the exercise price to $204 from $75 and adding a cashless exercise feature at the board's option, Kilpatric said.

IKON provides total office solutions, including copier and printing systems, computer networking and digital document services, copy center management, technology training and electronic file conversion.
